scope: Proposition 9.1 (Low sensitivity) of the manuscript “Single-exponential recovery and bounded-price strictness for metric k-median” (preprints/Single-Exponential-Recovery-and-Bounded-Price-Strictness-for-Metric-k-Median-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 125 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 823fdb284a7d3c0e), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 46. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: With these fixed parameters, suppose k > 2L and optk−2L ≤ (1 + ξ) optk . (9.3) Put h = k − L. In polynomial time one can compute a real facility set S of size k with cost(S) ≤  2 − c 100  opth ≤  2 − c 100  (1 + ξ) optk . (9.4) The algorithm does not need to test Equation (9.3).
